items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: Yeah, at that time we had Nick Gaglianna as our manager.

ctx.x: What about, where else on Burden did you play apart from...

Well, now, let me see now. I think we played a little short time at the Silver Slipper. Yeah, at that time we had Nick Gaglianna as our manager. We got us a job there and we stayed there for a while. Then they brought in a band from England and they got rid of them, I think, in a week's time because they didn't like the way they was dressing with that long hair and all that. So they soon got rid of them and we played at the Mardi Gras Lounge, Sydney. We played there for quite a while. And we played at the Paddock…
What was it like playing on Burden Street?
